name: nsfw-scan
desc: Free, open-source NSFW scanner for Windows — local ONNX classifier flags and quarantines images, nothing uploaded. 100 MB portable, MIT.
features: ✅ **Local classifier inference** — ONNX model runs on your GPU or CPU; images are never uploaded anywhere
✅ **Threshold control** — one slider separates safe, borderline and flagged, with per-class scores shown
✅ **Quarantine folder** — flagged files moved with a manifest, so nothing is deleted before you look
✅ **Keyboard review grid** — arrow through results, keep or restore each item in a fast pass
✅ **CSV report** — every file with score and decision for audit trails
✅ **Safe re-scan** — restore from quarantine and rescan after tuning thresholds
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, classifier downloads separately, offline after that, MIT
compare: | Feature | **nsfw-scan** | Cloud moderation APIs | Python scripts | Dataset checkers online |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Paid per call | Free, OSS | Free accounts |
| Images stay local | **Yes** | No upload | Yes | No upload
| Keyboard review pass | **Yes** | No | No | Partial
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | API only | Python env | Browser
faqQ: how to scan a large image dataset for NSFW content without uploading it?
faqA: Moderation APIs want per-image fees and a full upload of private datasets, and open scripts stop at printing scores. nsfw-scan runs the classifier locally and gives you a quarantine folder plus a keyboard review pass. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline, and nothing leaves the machine.
s1: Dark scan view (#121417, red #EF4444): scan progress at 61 percent over a 12,400 file set, score histogram right, flagged count chip reading 37 items.
s2: Review grid: flagged thumbnails with score badges, keep and quarantine buttons highlighted, keyboard hint strip reading arrows to move, space to keep.
s3: Quarantine summary: 37 files listed with original paths, manifest export button, restore selected action, folder size chip reading 214 MB quarantined.
